issue.title: Extend incremental Agents refresh to Status grouping
issue.description: Proposed by sase-127.4 note 3 after the active-filter flicker fix was verified. Status grouping still takes the display_fallback: unsupported_grouping full-rebuild path under live refreshes, while Standard, Machine, and the verified Project-grouping path avoid steady-state rebuilds when membership is unchanged. Determine the Status-panel safety invariants, admit BY_STATUS to the incremental diff path when the rendered widget tree and panel membership are stable, retain a full rebuild for real status-bucket membership changes, and add focused/perf regression coverage.

task_type_fields.proposal: Allow stable Status-grouped Agents views to use the incremental display diff path instead of rebuilding all panels on every refresh; preserve rebuilds when status bucket membership actually changes and cover both cases.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-127 fixed active-search rebuilds, load-tier oscillation, and duplicate fleet repaints. Its approved acceptance explicitly covered the stable-query path and observed Status grouping as a pre-existing unsupported-grouping limitation, not as a regression caused by the epic.

evidence.note: Independent live recurrence on athena, 2026-09-18: user reports the @epic tribe panel still disappears and reloads frequently. Verified this host's persisted grouping is by_status (~/.sase/grouping_mode.txt), and the sase-127 incremental display path admits only STANDARD/BY_MACHINE — src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_display.py:259-263 records display_fallback=unsupported_grouping and _display_panel_patches.py row patch/remove paths likewise bail — so under live agent churn every finalized list replacement full-rebuilds all panels, unmounting @epic. Part of the user's observation window is separately explained by the running TUI (PID 3144340, started 2026-09-16 14:38, editable install) predating all sase-127 commits, but after a restart BY_STATUS grouping will keep full-rebuilding; that residual is exactly this task's scope. A remediation plan covering this task plus stale-running-process detection is being proposed via sase plan propose.

payload.entry: Implemented by epic sase-12p phase sase-12p.1 in commit 1fa7e5fc3a: stable BY_STATUS membership now uses incremental panel and row patch/remove paths, while bucket/subgroup/anchor changes fall back under status_membership_change. Focused grouping, row-removal, trace, and perf guards cover both paths; phase sase-12p.3 added live-churn panel-mount regression coverage in 1af9c0b7b2 and completed a 30-minute athena soak. Repository-wide just check passed on the integrated tree (monitor xmbwyqm34e0k, exit 0).
